papers.title: Sanctions-Resilient Reserve Architecture: The Convex Monetary Anchor Framework (CMAF)
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「货币政策与宏观经济」领域，主题为：Sanctions-Resilient Reserve Architecture: The Convex Monetary Anchor Framework (CMAF)。涉及关键词：Diversification (marketing strategy)、Geopolitics、Economics。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: QRAFTI: An Agentic Framework for Empirical Research in Quantitative Finance
papers.abstract: We introduce a multi-agent framework intended to emulate parts of a quantitative research team and support equity factor research on large financial panel datasets. QRAFTI integrates a research toolkit for panel data with MCP servers that expose data access, factor construction, and custom coding operations as callable tools. It can help replicate established factors, formulate and test new signals, and generate standardized research reports accompanied by narrative analysis and computational traces. On multi-step empirical tasks, using chained tool calls and reflection-based planning may offer better performance and explainability than dynamic code generation alone.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一个多智能体框架，旨在模拟定量研究团队的部分工作流程，并支持针对大规模金融面板数据集的因子研究。RAFTI将面板数据研究工具包与MCP服务器集成在一起，这些服务器将数据访问、因子构建以及自定义编码操作作为可调用的工具提供。该框架能够帮助复制现有的研究因子，构建和测试新的研究指标，并生成包含叙述性分析及计算过程记录的标准研究报告。在涉及多步骤的实证研究中，采用链式工具调用和基于反射的规划方法，相较于单纯的动态代码生成方式，能够提升研究的性能和可解释性。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: Dissecting AI Trading: Behavioral Finance and Market Bubbles
papers.abstract: We study how AI agents form expectations and trade in experimental asset markets. Using a simulated open-call auction populated by autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents, we document three main findings. First, AI agents exhibit classic behavioral patterns: a pronounced disposition effect and recency-weighted extrapolative beliefs. Second, these individual-level patterns aggregate into equilibrium dynamics that replicate classic experimental findings (Smith et al., 1988), including the predictive power of excess demand for future prices and the positive relationship between disagreement and trading volume. Third, by analyzing the agents' reasoning text through a twenty-mechanism scoring framework, we show that targeted prompt interventions causally amplify or suppress specific behavioral mechanisms, significantly altering the magnitude of market bubbles.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】我们研究了人工智能代理在实验性资产市场中如何形成预期并进行交易。通过使用由自主大型语言模型（LLM）代理参与的模拟公开拍卖实验，我们得出了三个主要发现：首先，人工智能代理表现出典型的行为特征，包括明显的倾向效应（即投资者倾向于根据最近的信息做出决策）以及基于最新信息的预测性信念；其次，这些个体层面的行为模式会汇聚成市场均衡动态，再现了经典的实验结果（Smith等人，1988年），例如超额需求对未来价格的影响以及观点分歧与交易量之间的正相关关系；最后，通过分析代理的推理文本并运用二十种机制评估框架，我们发现有针对性的提示干预能够因果性地放大或抑制某些特定行为机制，从而显著改变市场泡沫的规模。。研究方法：实验方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Fertility in Honduras
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of fertility in Honduras, using data from the period 1991-2022. Equations are estimated to identify the role of variables from the real, monetary, and labor sectors on fertility. The results show that fertility is mainly determined by female unemployment rates, salaried employment rates, and self-employment rates, with investment and exports also playing a role. A result of particular interest is the role of the economic dynamism of other Central American countries on Honduran fertility, which highlights the existence of a regional fertility “network”.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文利用1991至2022年的数据，研究了洪都拉斯生育率的决定因素。通过建立方程模型，分析了实体经济、货币市场和劳动力市场各变量对生育率的影响。研究结果表明，生育率主要受女性失业率、有薪就业率以及自雇率的影响，同时投资和出口也对生育率具有一定的作用。一个特别值得关注的现象是其他中美洲国家的经济活力对洪都拉斯生育率的影响，这表明该地区存在一种“生育率网络”效应。。

papers.title: Circular Economy Practices, Environmental Cost and Economic Performance: eempirical Evidence from Traditional Craft Villages in Vietnam
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: Sustainable development in traditional craft villages in Vietnam is increasingly challenged by resource inefficiencies, waste generation, and environmental pressures, highlighting the urgent need for strategies that balance economic and environmental outcomes. Based on the Natural Resource-Based View by Hart (1995), this study investigates how circular economy practices including resource efficiency, reuse and recycling, cleaner production and eco-innovation, and industrial symbiosis affect perceived environmental costs and economic performance in these small-scale, resource-constrained production settings. Data were collected from 317 firms, and analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) and ANOVA to test the proposed hypotheses. Results show that all CE practices significantly increase perceived environmental costs, which in turn positively influence economic performance. Firm age positively affects performance, whereas firm size has a negative impact. The findings provide actionable insights for firms and policymakers to enhance sustainability and economic efficiency in traditional craft villages.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】越南传统手工艺村的可持续发展日益面临资源利用效率低下、废弃物产生以及环境压力等问题，这凸显了制定能够平衡经济与环境成果的策略的紧迫性。本研究基于Hart（1995）提出的“基于自然资源的视角”，探讨了循环经济实践（包括资源高效利用、再利用与回收、清洁生产、生态创新以及产业共生）如何影响这些资源受限的小规模生产环境中的环境成本感知与经济绩效。研究通过调查317家企业收集数据，并运用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）和方差分析（ANOVA）对假设进行验证。结果表明，所有循环经济实践均显著增加了环境成本感知，但这种增加反而对经济绩效产生了积极影响；企业成立时间对经济绩效具有正向促进作用，而企业规模则具有负面影响。这些发现为企业及政策制定者提供了切实可行的建议，以提升传统手工艺村的可持续性与经济效率。。

papers.title: The Impact of Maternal Education on Early Childhood Development -- by Moriam Khanam, Mohammad Hajizadeh, Casey Warman
papers.abstract: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7  percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区针对女学生的中学助学金计划所带来的外生性变化，来估计母亲教育水平对儿童早期发展的影响。通过分析2019年孟加拉国多项指标集群调查的数据，我们发现获得助学金的五年时间使母亲的受教育年限平均增加了约一年。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲受教育年限每增加一年，儿童在0-10分制的早期发展评估得分会上升0.5分，其中整体发展准备程度提高7.5个百分点，读写能力（7.7个百分点）和身体发展（1.9个百分点）也有所改善。这些结果在不同研究设定下均具有稳定性。我们还探讨了母亲教育对其他相关因素的影响，包括儿童的营养状况、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及儿童是否能够接受早期教育和保育服务。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高有助于提升儿童的体重与年龄比Z分数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并提高家庭成员与儿童互动的频率。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响表明，投资于提高教育水平尤为重要，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家中。。研究方法：调查数据、工具变量。

papers.title: Tariffs and the Term Structure of Inflation Expectations -- by Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Anthony M. Diercks, Aurélien Eyquem, Joon Kim
papers.abstract:
Inflation expectations derived from financial markets exhibited unprecedented dynamics in 2025: the correlation between one-year inflation swaps and one-year-ahead one-year forward rates turned significantly negative for the first time on record. We show that this decoupling occurred primarily on days when tariff news dominated market pricing, using a two-stage event classification validated by Bloomberg news trends. Standard small open-economy New Keynesian models in which tariffs generate a one-time price-level increase imply positive comovement across horizons and cannot explain this pattern. 
We explain these occurrences through the lens of an amended small open-economy New Keynesian model. Three ingredients prove critical for reproducing the observed negative conditional correlation between spot and forward inflation after tariff shocks: targeting year-on-year inflation, substantial interest-rate inertia, and persistent tariffs. Under empirically plausible calibrations, the model generates a negative correlation conditional on tariff shocks while preserving a positive unconditional correlation, suggesting that the 2025 twist in the term structure reflects expectations of a persistent policy response to trade shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】2025年，来自金融市场的通胀预期表现出前所未有的动态变化：一年期通胀互换合约与一年期远期利率之间的相关性首次出现了显著的负相关。我们通过使用由彭博新闻趋势验证的两阶段事件分类方法发现，这种脱钩现象主要发生在关税新闻主导市场定价的时期。传统的、适用于小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯主义模型认为关税只会引发一次性的价格水平上涨，这些模型无法解释这种负相关现象。

我们通过修正后的小型开放经济体新凯恩斯主义模型来解释这些现象。在该模型中，有三个关键因素对于再现关税冲击后现货通胀与远期通胀之间的负相关关系至关重要：一是将通胀目标设定为同比通胀率；二是利率具有较大的惯性；三是关税政策会持续实施。在符合实证合理性的参数设定下，该模型能够在考虑关税冲击的情况下解释负相关关系，同时仍能保持通胀率之间的正无条件相关性。这表明2025年通胀期限结构的变化反映了市场对贸易冲击将引发持续政策反应的预期。。

papers.title: O‘ZBEKISTONDA PENSIYA TIZIMINING MOLIYAVIY BARQARORLIGI: DEMOGRAFIK O‘ZGARISHLAR VA UZOQ UMR KO‘RISHNING TA’SIRI
papers.abstract: This study presents an in-depth analysis of the current state of the Uzbek pension system and the impact of demographic changes and life expectancy on pension liabilities. The size of pension reserves, the present value of liabilities, and financial sustainability indicators were calculated using actuarial models
papers.summary_zh: 【保险与养老】本研究深入分析了乌兹别克斯坦养老金体系的现状，以及人口变化和预期寿命对养老金负债的影响。通过精算模型，计算了养老金储备的规模、负债的现值以及财务可持续性指标。。

papers.title: RIVOJLANGAN MAMLAKATLARDA XOʻJALIK YURITUVCHI SUBYEKTLARNI MOLIYALASHTIRISH MEXANIZIMLARI VA ULARNI MAMLAKTIMIZDA QOʻLLASH
papers.abstract: This article analyzes the economic efficiency and organizational mechanisms of economic entities in developed countries. The results of the study show that the possibilities of creating a favorable financial environment for economic entities by studying foreign experiences and adapting them to the economy of our country were considered. At the same time, based on the results of the analysis, specific recommendations were developed in the areas of further improving state policy, introducing new financing mechanisms and eliminating existing problems
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文分析了发达国家经济实体的经济效率及其组织机制。研究结果表明，通过借鉴国外经验并将其适应于我国的经济状况，可以为经济实体创造有利的金融环境。在此基础上，根据分析结果提出了具体建议，涉及进一步改进国家政策、引入新的融资机制以及解决现有问题等方面。。

papers.title: Can Institutional Integration of Western Balkans Stock Exchanges Strengthen Monetary Transmission?
papers.abstract: This paper asks how institutional stock-market integration reshapes the transmission of monetary policy through asset prices in small open economies. Motivated by the persistent segmentation of Western Balkan capital markets, we develop a two-stage counterfactual transmission framework to identify how stock-exchange consolidation would alter the elasticity of market valuations to monetary shocks.   First, a synthetic-control simulation constructs a counterfactual integrated Western Balkan stock exchange comprising Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, and Serbia, benchmarked to the Baltic OMX merger, thereby quantifying the structural valuation gains of institutional integration. Second, we identify exogenous monetary-policy innovations using a Taylor-rule framework augmented with inflation and output forecasts and reserve adjustments. These shocks are then embedded within a Local-Projections estimator à la Jordà (2005) to trace the dynamic responses of market capitalisation under fragmented and integrated market regimes.   The results point to a systematic amplification of monetary-policy transmission through the asset-price channel once markets are unified. Following a policy tightening of about 100 basis points, equity valuations fall roughly twice as strongly under integration than under fragmented markets. Additionally, we find that integration alters the sensitivity of monetary transmission itself: the initial pass-through intensifies, but its marginal responsiveness to further integration declines over time, signalling the consolidation of a new steady-state regime.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】本文探讨了制度性股市整合如何重塑小开放经济体中货币政策通过资产价格传导的机制。鉴于西巴尔干地区资本市场的长期分割现象，我们构建了一个两阶段反事实分析框架，以分析股市整合会如何改变市场估值对货币冲击的敏感度。首先，通过合成控制模拟方法构建了一个整合后的西巴尔干股市（涵盖波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那、北马其顿及塞尔维亚），并将其与波罗的海地区的 OMX 合并案例进行对比，从而量化制度整合所带来的市场估值提升效应。其次，我们利用包含通胀与产出预测以及储备调整因素的泰勒规则框架来识别外生性的货币政策变化。随后，将这些货币政策冲击纳入 Jordà（2005）提出的局部投影估计方法中，以分析市场在分割与整合两种市场体制下的动态反应。

研究结果表明，一旦市场实现统一，货币政策通过资产价格渠道的传导效应会得到系统性增强。在货币政策收紧约100个基点后，整合市场下的股票估值跌幅约为分割市场下的两倍。此外，我们还发现市场整合改变了货币政策传导的机制本身：货币政策的初始传导效应会增强，但随着时间的推移，其对进一步整合的边际响应会减弱，这表明市场已逐渐形成一种新的稳态机制。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Pseudo-Substitutability: A Maximal Domain for Pairwise Stability in Matching Markets with Contracts
papers.abstract: We study the existence of pairwise stable allocations in matching markets with contracts and propose a domain restriction that guarantees their existence. Specifically, we define pseudo-substitutable preferences, a domain that strictly extends the classical notion of substitutability while still preserving the existence of pairwise stable allocations. This domain accommodates limited complementarities among contracts while retaining enough structure to preserve the key stability properties of substitutable preferences. Moreover, we show that, among all preference domains that contain the classical substitutable domain and guarantee the existence of pairwise stable allocations, the pseudo-substitutable domain is maximal. Our results establish that pairwise stability extends well beyond the classical substitutable domain.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了存在契约的匹配市场中成对稳定配置的可能性，并提出了一种能够保证这些配置存在的领域限制条件。具体而言，我们定义了“伪可替代偏好”这一概念，它严格扩展了传统的可替代性定义，同时仍能确保成对稳定配置的存在。这种偏好结构能够容纳契约之间的有限互补性，同时又保留了足够的结构以维持可替代偏好的关键稳定性特征。此外，我们证明了在所有包含传统可替代偏好领域且能保证成对稳定配置存在的偏好领域中，“伪可替代偏好”领域是最大的。我们的研究结果表明，成对稳定性远远超出了传统可替代偏好的适用范围。。
